title.narrative: Morocco Municipal Solid Waste Management Support Program

description.narrative: The Program Development Objective is to enhance the financial and environmental performance of the Municipal Solid Waste Management sector in the Program area.

The proposed operation will support the Government's objective of transitioning to a more financially and environmentally sustainable Municipal Solid Waste Management system in Morocco. As such, The operation will contribute to the implementation of the National Municipal Solid Waste Valorization Program (PNVDM) as well as key associated reform priorities, forming the Government Program.The operation includes a Program for Results, complemented by an Investment Project Financing (IPF) component, with an overall envelop of US$ 250 m. 1. The PforR (US$244 m) will support the Government program focusing on three strategic results areas (RAs) : RA I: Strengthening the Governance, Policies and Management of the MSW Sector (US$56.5 million) RA II: Improving the Financial Performance of the MSW Sector (US$85.5 million) RA III: Enhancing the Environmental Performance of the MSW Sector (US$102 million)Eight critical Disbursement Linked Indicators distributed across the three RAs will contribute to achieving the Program Development Objective. 2. IPF component (US$5.4 million) :Complementing the PforR Program will be an IPF-financed Technical Assistance component. This component is designed to support the effective implementation of the Program and facilitate its replicability, with sustainable outcomes. It provides policy guidance, technical specifications, quality control, and oversight for several design elements of the Program, benefiting from international experience and the sharing of best practices. It will ensure effectiveness and efficiency of overall Program implementation, including program coordination, monitoring, and verification of development results, bearing in mind the institutional complexity and the need to facilitate fluid implementation arrangements. In addition, this component will contribute to facilitating the replicability of good practices established within the framework of the PforR beyond the Program area, notably through support for the adoption of sector management standards and norms, as well as planning and monitoring tools. More specifically, this component would support the following activities : (i) MSW Sector Financing Study, (ii) MSW Sector Governance Study, (iii) Development of an MSW MIS, (iv) Development of Environmental Performance Guidelines for MSW Landfills, Treatment Facilities and Closure of Uncontrolled Abandoned Landfills, (v) Technical and Financial Assessment of Treatment of Accumulated Stocks of Leachate, (vi) Study for the development of an integrated MSW management system promoting circular economy and assessment of its socioeconomic impacts, (vii) Waste Pickers Integration in MSW Management, and (viii) Program Implementation Support.
